title: Microsoft Teams Rooms: enhanced IntelliFrame uses an AI data channel from intelligent cameras
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, automatic enablement and Teams Rooms Pro requirement agree with Microsoft's notice and roadmap. The existing recognition controls are documented and distinguished from the still-undocumented AI data channel switch; add the direct reference for the face-enrollment command.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans enhanced IntelliFrame using an expanded AI data channel on intelligent cameras.
claims.quote: We are introducing enhanced IntelliFrame capabilities for Teams Rooms on Windows using an expanded AI data channel on certified intelligent cameras.

claims.claim: The enhanced experience is for Teams Rooms on Windows.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms on Windows users can now benefit from next generation IntelliFrame features on certified AI-capable cameras with on-device video processing.

claims.claim: Certified AI-capable cameras provide on-device video processing.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms on Windows users can now benefit from next generation IntelliFrame features on certified AI-capable cameras with on-device video processing.

claims.claim: Existing IntelliFrame people recognition requires a room recognition configuration in addition to enrollment.
claims.quote: In order for people recognition to function, you need to prepare your organizations by enabling Face enrollment and People recognition.

claims.claim: Face recognition identifies people using biometric face profiles.
claims.quote: Voice and face recognition only works if end users have completed enrollment by creating their biometric profiles in Teams.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The organisation is responsible for local-law compliance, including notice, consent and data retention.
claims.quote: You're responsible for compliance with local laws and regulations when you install an AI intelligent camera and use Face Enrollment and People Recognition in a particular jurisdiction, including with respect to obligations around notice, consent, and data retention.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft asks for signage outside rooms with an AI intelligent camera.
claims.quote: Please install appropriate signage outside any meeting room, where you install an AI intelligent camera, advising people about the people recognition, face enrollment, and voice recognition features.

claims.claim: Users choose whether to enroll through their Teams Recognition settings.
claims.quote: Enrollment starts in the Teams app: users go to Settings > Recognition and, depending on how their Enterprise administrator has enabled the feature for them, opt in to either express enrollment or active enrollment.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; controls[1].governs; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Teams AI policy controls which users can enroll face and voice profiles.
claims.quote: Enterprise administrators can turn on or off use of voice and face recognition and voice and face enrollment for specific users or groups using the Teams AI Policy.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The device Face Recognition setting is in Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal at Rooms > Settings > Recognition > Configure with device settings > Face Recognition.
claims.quote: Select Rooms. Select Settings followed by the Recognition tab. Enable Configure with device settings. Modify to the desired configuration. | Face Recognition | Off | Users with enrolled face profile are identified with their face when using this device.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -RoomPeopleNameUserOverride On sets the meeting-policy control for video-based people identification.
claims.quote: On: Policy value allows People recognition option on Microsoft Teams Rooms under call control bar.

claims.claim: Device settings and meeting policies are alternative recognition configurations, and Microsoft recommends device settings.
claims.quote: Recognition in Teams Rooms can be configured through either device-level settings or a Teams Meeting policy. We recommend using device-level settings because meeting policy-based configuration will be retired in the future.

claims.claim: Meeting policy-based recognition configuration will be retired.
claims.quote: Meeting policy-based configuration will be retired in the future.

claims.claim: An administrator UI for configuring Teams AI enrollment permissions is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams AI policy voice face enrollment Teams admin center EnrollFace enrollment settings. Read voice-and-face-recognition and Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy; policy is PowerShell-only. Teams admin center manages status and profile deletion, not these enrollment permissions.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity Global -EnrollFace Disabled disables face enrollment through the global Teams AI policy.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity Global -EnrollFace Disabled
Set Teams AI policy "EnrollFace" value to "Disabled" for global as default.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamsaipolicy to sources and use it as controls[1].api.docs; it gives the exact printed call and its parameter reference.

claims.claim: Enrollment is enabled by default, but users must still opt in.
claims.quote: By default, voice and face recognition is available and enrollment is enabled for all users in the organization. Even if the feature is available, users still need to opt in to enroll their voice and face

claims.claim: New-CsTeamsAIPolicy creates a custom enrollment policy that can be assigned to specific users with Grant-CsTeamsAIPolicy.
claims.quote:
New-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity DisableEnrollment -EnrollVoice Disabled -EnrollFace Disabled
Grant-CsTeamsAIPolicy -Identity DisableEnrollment -Identity testuser@test.onmicrosoft.com

claims.where: controls[2].ui and controls[2].api; Governance controls table; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No dedicated tenant-wide or per-room UI or automation switch for the enhanced IntelliFrame AI data channel is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams enhanced IntelliFrame AI data channel intelligent cameras configuration switch metadata; "IntelliFrame" "AI data channel" PowerShell XML configuration enable disable. Read recognition, camera-controls, cloud-intelliframe and XML references; found no dedicated channel switch.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented whether existing recognition settings govern the new AI data channel or its enhanced people labels.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms people recognition RoomPeopleNameUserOverride Face Recognition Pro Management portal; Teams enhanced IntelliFrame AI data channel intelligent cameras configuration switch metadata. Read people-recognition, multistream-intelliframe, cloud-intelliframe and MC1442614; no linkage stated.

claims.claim: Existing multi-stream IntelliFrame requires the end-user policy to allow voice and face enrollment.
claims.quote: End users policy configured to allow Voice and Face Enrollment.

claims.claim: Existing multi-stream people identification requires a scheduled meeting with the identifiable users on the invitation.
claims.quote: When you schedule a meeting, the users who wish to be identified must be invited to meeting or meeting forwarded to them before the meeting transcription is started.

claims.claim: Ad hoc and 1:1 meetings do not have face identification in the documented multi-stream experience.
claims.quote: Adhoc or 1:1 meetings won't have face identifications, where there's no Outlook appointment with a list of participants.

claims.claim: Enrollment permission and the configuration that lets a room use profiles are separate controls.
claims.quote: To provide granular controls for Enterprise administrators, there's a separate configuration to allow Teams Rooms to utilize user voice and face profiles to identify who is in a meeting room.

claims.claim: Teams admin center lets administrators view enrollment status and delete end-user voice and face profiles.
claims.quote: Enterprise administrators can now use Teams admin center to view end-user voice and face enrollment status and manage enrolled data directly from the admin experience. Enterprise administrators can also delete end-user voice and face profiles

claims.claim: The cited enrollment page gives no navigation path for its Teams admin center status and deletion experience.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams AI policy voice face enrollment Teams admin center EnrollFace enrollment settings. Read voice-and-face-recognition in full, including Manage enrollment data in Teams admin center; it describes viewing status and deleting profiles without navigation steps.

claims.claim: The existing people recognition page lists Face Recognition as Off by default.
claims.quote: | Face Recognition | Off | Users with enrolled face profile are identified with their face when using this device. Others are distinguished as meeting participants. |
